statutory.answer: Yes, the conduct falls within § 5324(a)(3) prohibits structuring
statutory.label: entailment
statutory.reasoning: The fact pattern shows multiple cash and card transactions, several of which exceed $10,000 and are executed in a pattern suggestive of structuring to evade reporting, which § 5324(a)(3) prohibits. Under 31 U.S.C. § 5324(a), a person who conducts one or more transactions in currency that are structured to avoid the reporting requirement and involve $10,000 or more is liable. Here the entity conducted numerous transactions, some above the $10,000 threshold, and the aggregate behavior aligns with the statutory elements, satisfying each requirement.
